explanation: Csaba–Shokoufandeh–Szemerédi (Combinatorica 23 (2003) 35–72), as cited in arXiv:1605.05599, prove BEC for Δ1 = 3 when n is sufficiently large. The formal statement: there is n0 such that for all graphs on ≥ n0 vertices with Δ1 ≤ 3 satisfying (Δ1+1)(Δ2+1) ≤ n+1, they pack. Δ1 ≤ 2 is covered by Aigner–Brandt, so combining gives Δ1 ≤ 3. Faithful.
